blocks.summary: Schemes — Pradhan Mantri Jan Vikas Karyakram (PMJVK):

items: Running from 2021 to 2025, focuses on the socio-economic development of minority communities
 Objective: Improve infrastructure, education, healthcare, & economic opportunities.
 Coverage: Areas with over 25% minority population within 15 km.
 Funding: Central and state government contributions.
It aims to reduce disparities and enhance the living standards of minorities in India.
